title: Basic Infrastructure Program (Bip), Construction of Road, Barangay Ipil to Barangay Lahong, San Fernando, Masbate
description: CONVERGENCE AND SPECIAL SUPPORT PROGRAM (CSSP) - BASIC INFRASTRUCTURE PROGRAM (BIP) - CONSTRUCTION OF ROAD, BARANGAY IPIL TO BARANGAY LAHONG, SAN FERNANDO, MASBATE, STA. 0+000 - STA. 1+200
colour_meaning: Check: not scored. Either a tested “looks fine on paper” pattern, or a single weak sign (for example an unusual price) that alone is not enough to score.

items.label: Very fast award after bid opening
items.detail: Award made 8 days after the bid deadline (past road contracts awarded this fast had about twice the odds of termination)

items.label: Two bidders
items.detail: 2 bidder(s) recorded. Not linked to failed contracts in past data, so not scored.

items.label: Regional cost factor
items.detail: Prices for similar works in Region V (Bicol Region) run ×1.13 the national median; adjusted for the region: ₱35.7M per km vs national 95th percentile ₱110.9M.

families.name: Contractor ownership, affiliation and bidding networks

items.label: Winner holds many of this office's contracts
items.detail: High same-office concentration observed (context only, not scored)

items.label: Political dynasties in the province (Ateneo dataset)
items.detail: 36% of Masbate's elected local positions were held by fat-dynastic officials after the 2025 election (27% in 1992); median province 28%; largest clan: Lim (2.6% of positions); family poverty incidence 41% (2012).

items.label: Potential dynasts after the 2025 election (House CPBRD inventory)
items.detail: 60% of elected officials in the province have potential dynastic links (national average 54.5%; broader name matching than the Ateneo measure).

items.label: Dynastic district representatives (2025)
items.detail: Tony Kho, Olga Kho, Tonton Kho (Ateneo dataset).

items.label: Political families in the province
items.detail: 2 of 3 elected officials in Masbate (2022-2025) have a relative also in elective office (67%; national median 25%).

items.label: District representative's family
items.detail: Ricardo Kho (Masbate's 1st congressional district): 3 relative(s) in elective office; Ara Kho (Masbate's 2nd congressional district): 3 relative(s) in elective office

items.label: Winner's other on-going roads
items.detail: A3 Construction & Supply has 2 on-going DPWH road(s) possibly stalled and 1 far behind schedule (weekly stage-3 list; DPWH progress data can lag).

assessment.derivation: 0 strong + 1 weak signal → below Medium (needs 1 strong or 2 weak); a single weak sign is shown as a Blue check case.

steps.title: Confirm the basic facts on the official DPWH page
sub: Budget, location, status, dates and bidders match this page.

steps.title: Open the bid documents
sub: Look for the quantities, a Bill of Quantities and technical specifications.

steps.title: Read Claude's check and confirm its points against the sources
Verify the risk: Procurement competition and bidding patterns
sub: Compare the bid-opening date with the Notice of Award date.
Ask whether post-qualification (checking the winner's documents and capacity) could be done that fast.

steps.title: Check site and field evidence
sub: Check the site before work starts: satellite imagery of the stretch, earlier contracts on the same road, and whether a local monitor (Bisto Proyekto, a TPM civil-society partner) can take geotagged photos later.

steps.title: Write down what you found and keep the documents you relied on
sub: Screenshots, Bill of Quantities pages, photos or letters: attach them with your decision.
